title: Trace runtime object-foundation protocol/category negative and malformed metadata outcomes
source:
// IMPLEMENTATION-ANCHOR: python scripts/check_objc3c_runtime_acceptance.py --case runtime-object-foundation-protocol-category
// Negative protocol/category fixture matrix and malformed metadata probe are checked-in repository evidence, not tmp report truth.

required_malformed_metadata_observations: unregistered protocol reference rejects registration with O3RT004
forward protocol reference rejects registration with O3RT004
missing category target rejects registration with O3RT004
conflicting category owner rejects registration with O3RT004
duplicate protocol requirement rejects registration with O3RT004
inherited protocol requirement conflict rejects registration with O3RT004
adopted protocol requirement conflict rejects registration with O3RT004
inherited forward protocol reference rejects registration with O3RT004

traceability_requirements: Each negative diagnostic result carries a durable .meta.json sidecar path
Each expected diagnostic code must appear in the sidecar required diagnostic tokens
Each diagnostic result must preserve source-stable line and column fields
No tmp path is cited as source truth for the protocol/category conformance mapping
